name: @nexus/shared
description: NEXUS OS — shared domain constants: roles, permissions, error-code contract. Framework-free.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=dist/index.mjs && node -e "console.log('[shared] ESM bundle -> dist/index.mjs')"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
